market.title: Bitcoin Up or Down - October 14, 5:40AM-5:45AM ET
market.question: Bitcoin Up or Down - October 14, 5:40AM-5:45AM ET
market.description:
This market will resolve to "Up" if the BTC/USDT price at the end of the time range specified in the title is greater than the price at the beginning of that range.

It will resolve to "Down" if the BTC/USDT price at the end of the time range is lower than the price at the beginning of that range.

If the two prices are exactly equal, the market will resolve 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is Chainlink, specifically the BTC/USDT data stream available at https://data.chain.link/streams/btc-usdt-topofbook-datalink?timeframe=1d&chart=candlestick.

To verify the final price, use the close price of the 5m candlestick just before the market's end time. For example, for a market running from 1:00 to 1:15 PM ET or 1:10 to 1:15 PM ET, use the close price of the 1:10 PM candlestick as the final price.

The Chainlink stream uses the mid-price, which is calculated as the average price between the bid and ask prices from Binance's Top of Book, converted into the quote currency.

This market is based solely on the price reported by the Chainlink BTC/USDT data stream, not on other sources or spot markets.

If Chainlink data is unavailable or otherwise unusable for resolution, the market will resolve based on a consensus of reliable sources.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if at any point between April 13th 00:00 AM ET and Dec 31, 2026 11:59 PM ET Justin Sun’s public address is removed from the blacklist on the official WLFI contract. Otherwise, it will resolve to “No”.

For the purposes of this market:

Justin Sun’s address is [redacted-address]

The WLFI contract’s address is [redacted-address]

The current blacklist status can be checked in this URL by calling the “isBlacklisted” function with Justin Sun’s address to check the “blacklistStatus”. https://etherscan.io/address/[redacted-address]#readProxyContract

As soon as the WLFI contract emits the event “SetBlacklistStatus([redacted-address], false)” this market will immediately resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether the address is later blacklisted again.

Only the blacklist status on Ethereum mainnet counts toward resolution for the addresses specified above. The blacklist status of any other address or blockchain will not count towards the resolution of this market.
